title: The app's Google Play release facts

lane.description: eas: EAS Build signs with EAS-managed credentials and EAS Submit uploads the gated file. local: Gradle signs with the upload key (plugins/with-upload-signing.ts) and scripts/release-android uploads through the Play Developer API.

applicationId.description: The production android.package. Play binds the app to it for good.

uploadCertificateSha256.description: The upload key certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint as Play Console (App integrity), keytool and eas credentials print it. Public; null until the first upload registers the key.

minTargetSdk.description: The lowest targetSdkVersion a release may have: Google Play's floor (36 since 2026-08-31) or higher.

uploadTrack.description: The testing track uploads go to. Production is reached only by promotion with a staged rollout.

rollout.description: Rising fractions of production users, starting at 0.2 or less and ending at 1.

releaseBranch.description: Local lane: the branch releases come from; the build refuses any other. Left out: main.

releaseNotesLanguage.description: Local lane: the language code of the release notes (--notes), the app's default store listing language as Play Console names it. Left out: en-US.

permissions.description: Every uses-permission of the release bundle (the app's own <package>.* permissions excepted).

playDeclaration.description: What was declared in Play Console, for permissions Play reviews against a declaration.
